permissions._comment_deny: Empty by choice. Nothing is hard-refused. This is a bundled, repo-level settings file: a deny on git commit / push (or rm) would also block the maintainer's own legitimate Claude-driven work in this repo, not just the engine. Every formerly-denied verb is ask-gated below instead, so the seatbelt is a prompt, not a wall. The explicit empty list keeps that decision visible in the diff.
permissions._comment_ask: Prompt before any of these. The mutating git verbs (push, commit, tag, reset, checkout, rebase, merge), the one release-publishing gh verb (gh release create), and recursive removes (rm -rf, rm -r) are gated here rather than denied, so a human confirms each one — belt-and-suspenders with the git.readonly lint in plugin/skill-engine/tests/doctrine.sh, which independently asserts the engine itself invokes no mutating git verb. Four of the five verbs commands/release.md forbids an agent from running on the maintainer's behalf (git commit, git push, git tag, gh release create) are covered here, so that standing constraint has mechanical backing committed to the repo rather than relying on whatever permission mode the session happens to be in; keep this list and that constraint in step. `git add` was deliberately dropped from this list — staging isn't publishing, and re-confirming it on every save was pure friction; release.md's prose prohibition on running it on the maintainer's behalf still stands, unenforced mechanically for that one verb. Writes land only inside the engine namespace (.claude/skills/**), where the engine proposes changes and stages removable .proposed* artifacts; permission patterns cannot scope a glob to those paths, so rm -r prompts on every recursive remove rather than shipping a hook to narrow it. Separation-by-condition: reads are auto-allowed, everything that mutates state asks first.
permissions._comment_allow: Read surface only. The engine reads installed skills and runs four read-only git invocations (diff --no-index, status, log, show), all of which the git.readonly lint whitelists as read-only — no mutating verb appears here.

_comment_hooks: Explicit empty hooks section. This bundled settings file registers zero hooks; the plugin's one narrow SessionStart bootstrap hook is declared in the plugin manifest and documented in SECURITY.md. This key is a visible commitment — any future hook proposal in this file appears as a diff.
